name: Earth & Beyond DIT
description: Preservation-first Net-7 modernization on Linux: isolated MariaDB 10.11, historical database import, and a native Linux Net-7 binary that reaches item loading. DIT player/object/movement seams come later.
buildCommand: cd tooling/linux-build && docker build -t net7-linux-build . && docker run --rm -v "$(pwd)":/output net7-linux-build bash -c "make -f Makefile.linux -j$(nproc) && cp Net7 /output/Net7-linux"
promptRules:
Do not modify the archival clone at sources/net7-kyp/.
Do not expose any service to public interfaces; localhost only.
Do not use net-7.org or local.net-7.org hostnames.
Do not normalize line endings or bulk-format historical source.
Do not edit the historical dump at database/historical/; use migrations.
Do not start E3 client work before the E2-D ABI audit passes.
Do not disturb FFXI, WoW, Xenogears, or Workbench running services.

launchProfile.statusCommand: check() { if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":$2 "; then echo "$1 up"; else echo "$1 down"; fi; }; check enb-database 13306; if pgrep -f 'Net7-linux' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'net7 up'; else echo 'net7 down'; fi; if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':3501 '; then echo 'sector up'; else echo 'sector down'; fi; if ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | grep -q ':443 '; then echo 'proxy-auth up'; else echo 'proxy-auth down'; fi
launchProfile.serviceLogCommand: case "{service}" in enb-database) docker compose --project-name enb-e2 -f deploy/e2/compose.yml logs --no-color --tail=200 enb-database ;; net7|sector|proxy-auth) tail -200 tooling/logs/Net7_server_* 2>/dev/null | tail -200 ;; *) echo "No log mapping for {service}" ;; esac
launchProfile.stopCommand: docker compose --project-name enb-e2 -f deploy/e2/compose.yml stop; pkill -f 'Net7-linux' 2>/dev/null || true
launchProfile.logsCommand: docker compose --project-name enb-e2 -f deploy/e2/compose.yml logs --no-color --tail=80; echo '---'; tail -80 tooling/logs/Net7_server_* 2>/dev/null || true
